proposal.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Simplifies instrumentation method matchers by removing unnecessary type constraints on unused arguments and redundant argument counts.

Uses positional `takesArgument(index, type)` matchers for the remaining type checks, including JDK types and known library-type alternatives. For example, Akka `scheduleOnce` now checks only its `Runnable` parameter instead of the full parameter list. Keeps exact numeric arity where needed for supported-overload selection, helper-call compatibility, or lifecycle distinctions.

Argument use includes binding through `@Advice.Argument` or access through `@Advice.AllArguments`.

Also extends `defineClass` regression coverage to the `ByteBuffer` overload and verifies that the before/after hooks share the same context.

Refs #20103.
proposal.title: Remove unused-argument type checks and redundant argument counts

Simplifies instrumentation method matchers by removing unnecessary type constraints on unused arguments and redundant argument counts.

Keeps compact `takesArguments(Type...)` matchers for fixed complete signatures composed entirely of accessible `java.base` types available at the minimum supported Java version, including unused parameters. Positional matchers cover library types, known type alternatives, and intentionally shared parameter lists. Exact numeric arity remains only for supported-overload selection, helper-call compatibility, or lifecycle distinctions.

Argument use includes binding through `@Advice.Argument` or access through `@Advice.AllArguments`.

Refs #20103.
